buyer_added_terms.text: 1. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 2. Inspection

Testing of Sample: The testing of advance sample and bulk sample during PDI will be carried at the designated AHSP labs.When testing facilities are not available, the facilities of Govt labs/NABL/Accredited labs will be utilized. The testing charges outside the designated AHSP labs to be borne by seller's. 3. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Delivery , installation and commissioning shall be completed within 20 days form the date of issued th e supply order. 2. The project shall be inspected by the board of officers nominated by the buyer payment shall be releas ed only after satisfactory installation and acceptance cert by the board. 3. The successful bidder shall submit all relevant documents including GST regn, PAN, warranty cert and invoice. 4. Any defect noticed during the warranty period shall rectified/replaced by the seller at no extra cost with in 15 days of intimation by buyer in writing. 5. The onsite warranty of the entire equipment will commence form the date of acceptance of complete equipment by bd of offrs. The warranty will be of one year. 6. The technician will visit the site one every six months form the date of acceptance to check serviceability of the equipment. 7. The technician will visit the site within three days of receiving a defect report from the buy er. 8. The seller provide a minimum two days comprehensive training to the buyers designated operators at the installation site. The training shall cover operation, basic maintenance and safe handling of the equip ment. The training shall be provided by qualified personnel of the seller at no additional cost of the buyer. . 9. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN.
c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.
